author: GamingBolt
description:
The Relic: First Guardian isn’t shy about showing its Soulslike influence, but underneath the familiar grim-fantasy setting lies a surprising number of ideas to tell its story diegetically. 

Likewise, an aggression-first combat system shows another significant deviation, with progression driven around discoverables rather than traditional leveling up. Developer Project Cloud Games is aiming to carve a unique identity for their action RPG. Here’s everything you need to know before you buy The Relic: First Guardian.
title: The Relic: First Guardian Looks Like No Ordinary Action RPG

author: GamingBolt
description:
Hell Let Loose: Vietnam takes the brutal, team-driven framework of its World War II-era predecessor and extracts it into one of history’s most unconventional conflicts. Studio Expression Games, alongside publisher Team17, reckon the Vietnam War is underrepresented in games, so their upcoming sequel aims to both honour the conflict’s complex history while delivering a fresh, formidable new entry worthy of the Hell Let Loose mantle. 

With renewed focus on authenticity, with dense jungle firefights and river-based combat, to helicopter deployment and underground tunnels, this standalone entry is set to sharpen the series’ hardcore edges. Whether you’re a returning veteran or a curious newcomer, here are 16 key things you should know before buying Hell Let Loose: Vietnam.
title: Hell Let Loose: Vietnam - 15 Things You Need To Know Before You Buy
